title: Tell HN: GitHub refuses to remove cracked copies of my software after a month
summary: A developer of Photopea, a browser-based photo editor, reports that GitHub refused to remove repositories containing AI-generated cracked copies of his JavaScript code with ads stripped out. After filing a DMCA takedown notice, GitHub cited 17 U.S. Code § 1201 and declined action. The developer seeks advice on legal recourse, suspecting automated rejection.
